name: remaining-lattice-identifier-migration
title: Rename remaining lattice role IDs, markers, schemas, and npm identities to proof-or-stop forms
description: After B-cc10, user-facing bins, state dirs, config filenames, and @proof-or-stop/core are migrated, but lattice still remains in agent role IDs, managed-block markers, persisted artifact schemas, the remote-push-approval schema, the root npm package name, sibling packages @lattice/utils and @lattice/lab, and the package.json bin alias lattice. This story retires those identifiers with dual-read compatibility so in-flight evidence and already-installed files keep resolving, while new writes use proof-or-stop forms. Signature salts and archived story body text stay frozen.
